content.comment_body: I have a question regarding remote login for updates. My device works well over LAN when set to 192.168.1.3 (previously set to 192.168.0.3). I tried using the [product_name] port mode system and forwarded port 8082, but it didn't work. IPs 192.168.1.100:8080 and 192.168.1.101:8081, used by two [product_name] devices, allow remote login. Does the [product_name] CMR 2040 require a dedicated port for remote access? Any suggestions for how to log in remotely are appreciated. Thank you.
Hello, The [product_name] CMR 2040 uses port 80 for HTTP and port 443 for HTTPS. You need to forward the port you intend to use, and it should work.
Hi, thank you for your help. Port 80 works perfectly for remote access. Thanks again!

analysis.insight_summary: The user had trouble logging in remotely to the [product_name] CMR 2040 when attempting to use a custom port (8082). Guidance clarified that ports 80 (HTTP) and 443 (HTTPS) are required for remote access, which resolved the issue once properly configured. The main confusion stemmed from uncertainty over which ports were needed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated being able to configure custom ports for remote login on the [product_name] CMR 2040, similar to other [product_name] devices. They were looking for advice or documentation detailing the correct port settings.
